submitted_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(i.total) AS amount FROM public.invoice i JOIN public.customer c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2025-01-01' GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY amount DESC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 1;
validated_sql: SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(i.total) AS amount FROM public.invoice AS i JOIN public.customer AS c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE i.invoice_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND i.invoice_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.customer_id ORDER BY amount DESC, c.customer_id ASC LIMIT 1
